module.purpose: Defines the migration model and utilities used to validate, order, and construct schema migrations for persisted store data.
module.summary: This module provides migration declarations for record-, store-, and storage-scoped transformations, along with compatibility types for the legacy migration system. It constructs migration sequences, generates stable migration identifiers, combines dependency declarations, validates sequential identifiers, parses migration IDs, and performs dependency-aware topological sorting with cycle detection. It also defines migration result and failure-reason representations used by persistence code.
module.businessContext: Supports versioned persistence for tldraw stores and their records. Failures can prevent stored documents from loading or cause incompatible schema data to be applied.

detail.name: squashDependsOn
preconditions: sequence is an array whose elements are Migration or StandaloneDependsOn values.
Each element is non-null and supports the shape required by its declared union member.
postconditions: Returns a Migration[] containing all input migrations in their original relative order.
Standalone dependsOn declarations that precede a migration are appended to that migration's dependency list in their original sequence order.
Standalone dependsOn declarations without a following migration are not represented in the result.
invariants: The result contains no standalone dependency declarations.
Existing migration dependsOn entries are preserved and remain after merged standalone dependencies.
edgeCases: An empty sequence returns an empty array.
A sequence containing only standalone dependency declarations returns an empty array.
A standalone dependency declaration before a migration is merged into that migration.
Multiple consecutive standalone dependency declarations before a migration are merged in their original order.
A sequence containing migrations without standalone declarations returns the migrations in the same order, without changing their dependency values.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Behavior is not defined for nullish or malformed values outside the Migration | StandaloneDependsOn type union.

detail.summary: Transforms a sequence containing migrations and standalone dependency declarations into migrations only. Standalone dependencies are merged into the next migration in sequence order, while declarations without a following migration are discarded.

specTests.then: The result contains one migration whose dependsOn value is ["a", "b"].

parameters.type: { recordType: string; filter?(record: UnknownRecord): boolean; retroactive?: boolean; sequenceId: string; sequence: Omit<Extract<Migration, { scope: 'record' }>, 'scope'>[] }

preconditions: opts.sequence is an array of record migration definitions without the scope property.
Any supplied filter functions accept an UnknownRecord and return a boolean.
postconditions: Delegates creation of the resulting MigrationSequence to createMigrationSequence.
Every mapped migration has scope set to 'record'.
Every mapped migration filter requires the record type to equal opts.recordType.

A sequence-level filter, when present, must return true for the mapped filter to return true.

When retroactive is explicitly false, createMigrationSequence receives retroactive: false.
When no sequence-level filter is supplied, the sequence-level condition evaluates as true.
When no migration-level filter is supplied, the migration-level condition evaluates as true.
A record whose typeName differs from recordType is rejected by every generated filter.
An empty sequence is mapped to an empty sequence and passed to createMigrationSequence.

raises: Exceptions thrown by createMigrationSequence or by supplied filter callbacks propagate to the caller.

detail.summary: Creates a migration sequence for record-scoped migrations. Each migration is restricted to records matching the requested record type and, when provided, both migration-level and sequence-level filters.

specLiterals.role: Sets the scope of every generated migration and identifies the record migration type.

detail.name: sortMigrations
preconditions: Each migration has an identifier parseable by parseMigrationId.
Migration identifiers are suitable as unique graph keys.
postconditions: Returns all input migrations exactly once in a dependency-valid execution order.
Every present predecessor migration in the same sequence appears before its successor.
Every explicit dependency that is present in the input appears before the migration that depends on it.
When multiple migrations are ready, selection follows the distance-minimizing urgency ordering.
invariants: A migration is processed only after all present implicit and explicit dependencies have been processed.
An explicit dependency edge that duplicates an implicit predecessor edge is counted only once.
Explicit dependencies referring to migrations absent from the input do not create graph edges.
If the input is non-empty and not cyclic, the result length equals the input length.
edgeCases: An empty migrations array returns an empty array.
A migration whose explicit dependency is absent from the input is still eligible based on the dependencies that are present.
A migration explicitly depending on its implicit predecessor does not receive a duplicate dependency edge.
Circular implicit or explicit dependencies prevent completion and raise an assertion error.
Multiple migrations with zero in-degree are selected according to the urgency-based priority ordering rather than arbitrary dependency processing.

raises: Assertion error when circular dependencies prevent all migrations from being processed

detail.summary: Sorts migrations into an execution order that satisfies implicit sequence and explicit dependency constraints while minimizing distance between migrations and their explicit dependencies.

specTests.then: The result is an empty array.
The result is app/1, app/2, lib/1, preserving the sequence dependency app/1 before app/2 and the explicit dependency app/1 before lib/1.
